oneOp: One op per call, as the only key: {"<op>": {...}}.
game_check: Facts on this game's running build. {oneOp} No op: look. look: the page as a player opens it, then a moment of play: errors with file:line, frame rate, both frames (play beside the reference picture). look with fresh: true also shows those frames to a separate model that knows only the brief: it names the biggest problems a player would see. final: your turn's last look, with a status line. The full check (the QA play, the first minute) runs on the build after your turn; the problems it finds come with your next message.
game_play: Drive the running game. {oneOp} act: input steps in order, up to 30 s of game time each act (stepped as fast as the page allows; the game stands still between acts), or decide: a script (a .mjs under .studio/bot/, or its source) exporting decide(obs) that returns the action names to hold this step, or false to stop; it plays a fresh run, called each fixed step with obs.t, state (GameState), player, keys and ctx, until the game is won or lost, it stops, or its seconds pass. It presses the player's own controls, so the answer says a script drove them, with the run's probe trail and an id to replay. Each act answers with the probe, game time against wall time, the first change after its first input, and one small frame; its screenshot steps' frames are listed by path (includeImage: true in act shows them too); viewport sets the page's size. With no sessionId it plays on in your open session, else opens one. close: ends it (your turn's end does too). eval: JavaScript in the playing page, with the run's ctx and GameState in scope; its JSON value back. replay: saved test plays every build replays; save names a run; run, at: a run at a second, as an image. model_sheet: named models from six sides, with size and cost.
game_assets: Art, sound and the look. {oneOp} search: the open library, as a contact sheet; add: files, credited. lock: STYLE.json for made things. pictures: HTML or SVG per data row, as sheets. A refusal says what is missing: tell the person.
game_blender: This game's managed Blender: a live scene, saved as the game's .blend after each change. {oneOp} code: runs bpy Python, printing what you need. look: the scene as an image; mode review renders the model export would write; fresh: true adds a separate model's view of its biggest visible defects. export: the objects as a GLB with its sidecar and what it measured. character: a rigged humanoid on the standard skeleton, sized. paint: textures from a turnaround sheet. animate: keys a move from poses on beats. asset_search, asset_import: Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Poly Pizza or library assets into the scene; a Poly Haven texture with applyTo goes under those parts' own materials. addon: installs a listed add-on once the person agrees. How: studio-skills/art-pipeline.md.
game_builds: Builds and undo. {oneOp} No op: list. list: builds, newest first; build: one, with what the harness measured on it. undo: takes a build out, later ones kept; to: goes back to it instead; only when the person asks. export: the Web release; zip: also a ZIP.
game_keep_going: Keep going, only when the person asks. No input: what it is doing. mode: on or off; budgetMinutes (null for none) on start or resume; steer: the person's words, its direction (with mode on they replace the last one). A message starting "Keep going · step N" is a step: do that one change.
game_copy: This chat's copy of the game, work not in the game yet. {oneOp} copies: the game's copies and this chat's place. bring_in: your copy, or a child chat's, into the game. update: the game's newer builds into your copy.
